title: Print the PDF from the built HTML page

fields.outcome: A reviewer receives a PDF of the same HTML page a reader opens, with a cover, chapter bookmarks, page numbers, and figures kept with their captions.
fields.scope: Print the PDF from the HTML document used for the HTML target, including its headings, screenshot figures, and video stills. Add a cover, a contents list with the chapter start page, a PDF bookmark per heading, and a running footer. Use Seite n von m when the walkthrough language is German and Page n of m otherwise. Keep each figure with its caption. An optional video still is shown in both the HTML and the PDF. Exclude version archives and derived artefacts.
fields.acceptance: The HTML page and the PDF contain the same section id, caption, and motion still. The PDF has an outline, a cover contents entry with the chapter page, and a localized page footer. A German walkthrough uses Seite n von m.
fields.decisions: One HTML builder feeds the page and the PDF. The PDF adds print-only cover, footer, and bookmarks. Page numbers in the contents list come from a second print pass. Other languages use the English page label.
fields.verification: Generate HTML and PDF for one chapter and check the page in a browser and the PDF text, outline, and footer. Repeat the footer check in German.
fields.dependencies: Uses the existing HTML generator and Playwright PDF printing.
fields.risks: The contents page number depends on text extracted from the PDF. A heading that is repeated later in the chapter can point at the later page. A viewer that strips PDF outlines still has the cover list.

criteria.expectation: The PDF is printed from the HTML page, including the section id, figure caption, and video still.
The PDF has a cover contents list with the chapter start page and an outline bookmark per heading.
The footer uses Page n of m, and Seite n von m when the walkthrough language is German.
A screenshot figure keeps its caption with the image in the printed document.
